NEW • TASHKENT INTERNATIONAL FINANCIAL CENTRE

TIFC: English Common Law & Tax Holidays Until 2076

Established by Presidential Decree UP-48 (30 March 2026) and the Constitutional Law on the Tashkent International Financial Centre (signed 13 July 2026), TIFC is a special legal and tax jurisdiction inside Tashkent. Mezon Advisory helps banks, funds, insurers and investors enter it: from eligibility and licensing to day-one compliance.

2076 Tax incentives guaranteed until 1 January 2076
English & Welsh common law and equity apply directly
0% Corporate tax on qualifying financial services income
0% Income tax for foreign employees of qualifying participants
5 yrs Visas for staff & families, with no work permit required

Corporate Tax Holiday

  • 0% corporate income tax on income from Islamic banking, investment & fund management, reinsurance & insurance brokerage, and brokerage / dealer / underwriting services
  • Exemption extends to related ancillary services
  • Exempt income must be accounted for separately

Capital Gains & Investment Income

  • No tax on gains from selling securities or shares in TIFC participants
  • Dividends & interest on exchange-listed securities exempt
  • Investment tax residency: foreign-source income exempt (annual residency fee applies)

Payroll & Talent

  • 0% personal income tax for foreign employees
  • Reduced 7% personal income tax for resident employees
  • Social tax exemption for qualifying financial-services participants

VAT, Property, Land & Customs

  • VAT exemption on qualifying financial services
  • Property and land tax exemption on TIFC facilities
  • No customs duties on imports by participants, staff and investment residents
ENGLISH LAW

English Law & Independent Court

  • English & Welsh common law, statutes and precedent apply directly
  • Tashkent International Commercial Court: first instance & appeal, foreign judges, English-language proceedings
  • Judgments enforceable across Uzbekistan

Currency & Capital Freedom

  • Contracts and settlements in any agreed foreign currency
  • Unrestricted repatriation of capital and income
  • Protection against confiscation, nationalisation and expropriation

How Mezon Advisory Gets You In

  1. Eligibility & structure review — map your activities to the qualifying service lists and model your tax position.
  2. Licensing — prepare and file your application with the TIFC Financial Services Authority.
  3. Set-up & substance — entity, office, bank accounts, visas for staff and families.
  4. Ongoing compliance — separate accounting for exempt income, IFRS reporting and audit.

Launch status: TIFC bodies are adopting implementing regulations within 12 months of the July 2026 Constitutional Law. The Centre's boundaries, final service lists, licence fees and tax-administration rules are being published in stages, and we track each one. QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Frequently Asked Questions

Key legal, financial, and tax questions answered transparently.

TIFC is a special jurisdiction in Tashkent created by Presidential Decree UP-48 (30 March 2026) and a Constitutional Law signed on 13 July 2026. English and Welsh common law applies, disputes go to the independent Tashkent International Commercial Court (English-language proceedings, foreign judges), and tax incentives run until 1 January 2076. Participants providing Islamic banking, investment and fund management, reinsurance and insurance brokerage, or brokerage, dealer and underwriting services are exempt from corporate income tax and social tax on that income. Foreign employees pay 0% personal income tax, resident employees 7%. Mezon Advisory assesses eligibility and prepares your Financial Services Authority licence application.

Yes. Uzbekistan law guarantees 100% foreign ownership through a Foreign Enterprise LLC (ИП ООО) or standard LLC. Investors from GCC nations (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, etc.) and worldwide enjoy equal rights, freedom to repatriate capital and profits in USD/EUR/AED, and comprehensive protections under the Law on Investments.

Under the standard regime: Corporate Income Tax (CIT) is generally 15%, Value Added Tax (VAT) is 12%, Personal Income Tax (PIT) is a flat 12%, and employer Social Tax is 12%. Small businesses with revenue under 1 billion UZS can opt for Turnover Tax (usually 4%). IT Park residents enjoy 0% CIT, 0% VAT, and 7.5% PIT.

Yes. Founded with deep expertise in Islamic finance, Mezon Advisory provides specialized advisory for Murabaha contracts, Sukuk issuance readiness, Shariah governance reviews, and halal investment structuring in compliance with AAOIFI standards and Uzbek commercial law.

Any company providing eligible IT, software development, AI, game dev, BPO, data processing, or tech export services can apply for IT Park residency regardless of physical location in Uzbekistan. Once accredited, the company is exempt from all corporate taxes, import customs duties on computer equipment, and benefits from a reduced 7.5% personal income tax on salaries.

Yes. Through an apostilled or legalized Power of Attorney (PoA), Mezon Advisory handles the entire setup: drafting bilingual Articles of Association, obtaining state registration with the Ministry of Justice, securing Tax IDs (INN), digital keys (ERI), and opening corporate multi-currency bank accounts (USD, EUR, AED, UZS) without requiring travel to Tashkent.
